title: Mammoth regional tailings dam is centrepiece of DRDGOLD's R10bn expansion
summary: JOHANNESBURG (miningweekly.com) – The centrepiece of the R10-billion five-project Vision 2028 of DRDGOLD is the mammoth regional tailings storage facility (RTSF) at Far West Gold Recoveries surface retreatment operation, near Carletonville, in South Africa’s Gauteng province.
